answer: A seeker bonds 17.1 POA and stamps an 11-byte chip at one licensed sparrow post cut into a public shale face, only in that post's 6-second pulse window after the epoch beacon. Two unaffiliated established clerks, one window each this epoch and from distinct cuts, rehash chip and beacon in 91 seconds. Auditors check chip-inside-pulse, matching hashes, and the one-post cap. A 5,800-key farm needs 99,180 POA and 11,600 exclusive clerk slots in that 91-second window. A missed pulse, a second stamp on the same post, or a shared cut burns 71% of the bond and benches those clerks for eight epochs.
